function: p. 1: Adversarial attack (PGD-based perturbations) on an autoencoder-based double RIS-MIMO link; the autoencoder is the attacked system, and security is not one of the seven areas.
notes: Excluded on function. The paper studies adversarial attacks: p. 1: "This paper explores adversarial attacks against a double reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted multiple-input and multiple-output (MIMO)-based autoencoder". The proposed attack RMAEP is an iterative PGD algorithm with no trained parameters (Algorithm 1, p. 3), and the autoencoder (p. 2-3) is only the victim: p. 4: "we will study the effectiveness of adversarial attacks in damaging legitimate devices". Attack and security analysis is not one of the seven areas (it is akin to anti-jamming). no_learning could also be argued because the proposed method is an iterative algorithm; function was chosen because a learned transceiver (RIS phase prediction and decoder, p. 3) is present. The PDF is the arXiv preprint 2410.20103v1 (26 Oct 2024) and prints no DOI.
